description: Modified-sandwich SettingsModel checkpoint: SerializationTests::ColorScheme, GlobalSettings, Profile, plus color-scheme/profile/global mutation round-trips are backed by safe Rust owners with Microsoft-derived typed JSON evidence.

entries.notes: Microsoft SerializationTests::ColorScheme uses the same Campbell object as the existing ColorScheme contract: foreground #F2F2F2, background #0C0C0C, cursor #FFFFFF, selection #131313 and all sixteen ANSI table colors. The safe Rust ColorScheme owner parses that exact vector and projects a structure-identical typed JSON value, satisfying the FromJson/ToJson round-trip without introducing a second settings owner.

Microsoft round-trips both the full GlobalAppSettings vector and a minimal defaultProfile/actions/keybindings vector. Safe Rust SettingsDocument retains the shared typed JSON tree as its serialization source of truth; the Microsoft-derived witness uses those exact vectors, verifies structure-identical round-trip, and checks representative numeric, boolean, string, warning and empty-array settings without inventing a parallel serializer.

Microsoft round-trips six Profile vectors: the full Windows PowerShell profile, a minimal name-only profile, a nullable-color profile, explicit icon, null icon, and icon=none. Safe Rust routes these vectors through the existing Profile semantic owner before retaining the complete shared typed JSON tree, so migrated GUID/color/icon/history/directory/environment semantics are validated while unmigrated members remain lossless without a second profile serializer.

Microsoft loads a settings document containing user scheme MyScheme, changes foreground from #CCCCCC to #AABBCC and verifies ToJson persists that mutation while retaining the scheme. Safe Rust SettingsDocument owns the typed settings tree, performs that exact named-scheme mutation, and the Microsoft-derived witness additionally verifies unrelated defaultProfile/profiles and background survive unchanged.

Microsoft mutates profile zero historySize from 1000 to 5000, verifies commandline cmd.exe survives, then adds tabTitle NewTitle and verifies ToJson. Safe Rust SettingsDocument performs those exact typed mutations over the retained settings tree for both legacy profiles arrays and modern profiles.list shape.

Microsoft loads initialRows=30 and alwaysOnTop=false, mutates them through the global settings owner to 50 and true, then verifies serialization reflects both changes. Safe Rust SettingsDocument performs those exact typed root mutations while retaining defaultProfile and profiles unchanged.
